title: Animated Duck Riding a Bike
content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">A duck riding a bicycle</title>
  <desc id="desc">An animated duck pedals a bicycle across a sunny landscape.</desc>
  <style>
    .wheel { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite; }
    .rider { animation: bob .55s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center bottom; }
    .bike { animation: ride 3.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .cloud { animation: drift 14s linear infinite; }
    .cloud.two { animation-duration: 19s; animation-delay: -7s; }
    .ground { animation: groundMove 1.5s linear infinite; }
    .motion { animation: dash .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes bob { from { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-1deg); } to { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(1deg); } }
    @keyframes ride { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 50% { transform: translateX(22px); } }
    @keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(-120px); } to { transform: translateX(850px); } }
    @keyframes groundMove { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-90px); } }
    @keyframes dash { from { opacity: .25; transform: translateX(0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-10px); } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; }
    }
  </style>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#91dcff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e8f8ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#a9df86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#5dbb67"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect width="800" height="500" rx="28" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="690" cy="88" r="42" fill="#ffd75a" opacity=".95"/>
  <g class="cloud" fill="#fff" opacity=".82">
    <circle cx="125" cy="105" r="24"/><circle cx="153" cy="92" r="34"/><circle cx="190" cy="108" r="23"/><rect x="125" y="105" width="67" height="25" rx="12"/>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud two" fill="#fff" opacity=".7">
    <circle cx="470" cy="155" r="20"/><circle cx="496" cy="143" r="30"/><circle cx="530" cy="157" r="20"/><rect x="470" y="155" width="62" height="20" rx="10"/>
  </g>

  <path d="M0 294 Q135 230 270 292 T550 275 T800 285 V500 H0Z" fill="url(#hill)"/>
  <path d="M0 350 Q120 305 250 350 T500 340 T800 350 V500 H0Z" fill="#45a85b"/>
  <g class="ground" stroke="#2f914b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".8">
    <path d="M40 398l-8-15m12 15l8-20m72 35l-5-18m10 18l10-20m90 5l-7-18m12 18l9-22m85 35l-7-17m12 17l9-20m90 6l-7-18m12 18l9-20m92 30l-8-18m13 18l10-22m82 8l-7-17m12 17l9-20m78 32l-7-18m12 18l9-21m80 33l-7-18m12 18l9-20
    M0 448h45m35 0h65m44 0h52m40 0h80m38 0h61m42 0h73m38 0h70m40 0h60"/>
  </g>

  <g class="motion" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M178 286h-43"/><path d="M164 309h-58"/><path d="M194 332h-32"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bicycle and rider travel together -->
  <g class="bike">
    <!-- wheels -->
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle cx="290" cy="375" r="63" fill="#e9f4f5" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="9"/>
      <circle cx="290" cy="375" r="8" fill="#263b4a"/>
      <g stroke="#6b8996" stroke-width="3"><path d="M290 320v110M235 375h110M251 336l78 78M329 336l-78 78"/></g>
    </g>
    <g class="wheel">
      <circle cx="510" cy="375" r="63" fill="#e9f4f5" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="9"/>
      <circle cx="510" cy="375" r="8" fill="#263b4a"/>
      <g stroke="#6b8996" stroke-width="3"><path d="M510 320v110M455 375h110M471 336l78 78M549 336l-78 78"/></g>
    </g>
    <!-- frame, handlebars and seat -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#e45b43" stroke-width="9" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path d="M290 375l77-112 72 112H290l77-112"/>
      <path d="M439 375l71-112"/><path d="M510 263l25-18"/>
      <path d="M357 263h-31"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="367" cy="375" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="6"/>
    <path d="M367 375l-25-21m25 21l27 19" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- duck body and animated head -->
    <g class="rider">
      <ellipse cx="399" cy="218" rx="69" ry="74" fill="#f5c84c" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="7"/>
      <ellipse cx="399" cy="264" rx="48" ry="28" fill="#e9ad35"/>
      <path d="M365 219q-32 20-46 2q20-26 50-22" fill="#f5c84c" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="7"/>
      <circle cx="407" cy="150" r="49" fill="#f8d15b" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="7"/>
      <path d="M366 147q-20 6-46-8q26-23 55-10" fill="#ed8737" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="7"/>
      <circle cx="421" cy="139" r="7" fill="#263b4a"/>
      <path d="M380 112q24-31 61-2l-5 26h-61z" fill="#ee6251" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="7"/>
      <path d="M377 111q28-20 61 0" fill="none" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="6"/>
      <path d="M374 195q27 19 53 1" fill="none" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- legs -->
      <path d="M371 268l-5 83m55-84l-5 83" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M360 351h-27m80-1h27" stroke="#ed8737" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- arms -->
      <path d="M352 218l-7 43l28 2m87-43l10 42l24 1" fill="none" stroke="#263b4a" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <text x="400" y=" fifty" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#263b4a">QUACK! QUACK! 🚲</text>
</svg>
